name: Trainer Games
overview: Hosted by Emmy-nominated TV host, actress and celebrity fitness entrepreneur Amanda Kloots (The Talk, Blue Bloods), Trainer Games chronicles ten elite competitors — Chari Hawkins, Chris Griffiths, Dan Holguin, Darryl Williams, Divinity Gaines, Heather Gollnick, Nick Ullman, Nikki Keys, Kori Sampson, and Yanessa Navarro — as they fight their way through treacherous challenges set against stunning backdrops of Mauritius, an island in the Indian Ocean known for its adventure landscapes.
